0.original: Seigetsu the Enlightened would enlist your talent for enlisting others.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

25.original: Ride a mikoshi to the edges of Nhaama's Retreat and use the Wasshoi ability for the Namazu gatherers.

48.original: The mikoshi you helped us construct has made quite an impact on our people. We are currently in the process of building several more, but I fear their worth is significantly reduced if there are no bearers to parade them around...

49.original: Thankfully, in this case, my people are a simple breed. By merely demonstrating the majestic spectacle of our mikoshi in their immediate vicinity, they will soon clamor for the honor of bearing the load.

50.original: Go now to Gyotaku, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Claim a mikoshi, and soar across the steppe to where our gatherers toil on the edges of Nhaama's Retreat. The allure of your resounding “wasshoi” will not be denied!

54.original: Ready for your mikoshi? Up you go, then! Give those boys and girls a good “wasshoi” from me!

55.original: When the others returned with the mikoshi, I had thought your task successfully completed. But it seems you simply hopped down...or tumbled off. Here, why don't you try again, and keep a tighter grip this time, yes, yes?

56.original: How colorful and festive! When do <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> ever get to scatter confetti with wild abandon?

57.original: All we earn from this job is dry skin and skinned fins! We should head back and sign up to be mikoshi bearers!

58.original: Oh, have you come to lift our spirits!? Banish the drabness? There truly is nothing worth collecting around here...

59.original: Just Namazu-colored sand...and more Namazu-colored sand. I can't take this anymore! I quit! “Mikoshi bearer” is my true calling!

60.original: Oho! What a lively crew! Rambunctious! And here we are working our fins to the gristle...

61.original: Why don't <hex:021A020203>we<hex:021A020103> join the mikoshi bearers and enjoy ourselves for a change? Anything's better than grubbing in the mud! Yes, yes!

62.original: We Namazu were hatched to enjoy life─not slave away at these dreary chores! I want an exciting job like the mikoshi bearers!

63.original: Me too! This gathering nonsense can sink in the river for all I care!

64.original: These Namazu are busy harvesting supplies for the festival. Speak with Gyotaku at Dhoro Iloh to mount a mikoshi, and perform a rousing Wasshoi for the Namazu gatherers.

65.original: The effect of your demonstration has been all but instantaneous─we have already accepted several applications for our bearer positions. <sigh> The fact that my kin are so easily influenced is a blessing on occasion.

66.original: I have it on good authority, however, that the physical labor of a mikoshi bearer takes a terrible toll on the body. We shall have shirkers and deserters aplenty within the week, and will soon be calling again upon your powers of persuasion...
